# `ecs/EntitySchema.js`

> **Source:** `engine/ecs/EntitySchema.js`

EntitySchema.js - Unified JSON Schema for ECS Components Defines consistent data structures for all entity components: - Transform, PhysicsBody, Collider - Renderable, Light, Camera - ParticleEmitter, NavAgent - Snapshot formats for rewind All ECS code should use these schemas for consistency.

## Constants

- `FIELD_TYPES` — Common field types used across components
- `TRANSFORM_SCHEMA` — Transform component schema
- `PHYSICS_BODY_SCHEMA` — PhysicsBody component schema
- `COLLIDER_SHAPES` — Collider shapes
- `COLLIDER_SCHEMA` — Collider component schema
- `LIGHT_TYPES` — Light types
- `LIGHT_SCHEMA` — Light component schema
- `CAMERA_PROJECTIONS` — Camera projection types
- `CAMERA_MODES` — Camera modes
- `CAMERA_SCHEMA` — Camera component schema
- `RENDERABLE_SCHEMA` — Renderable component schema
- `EMITTER_SHAPES` — Emitter shapes for particle spawning
- `PARTICLE_EMITTER_SCHEMA` — ParticleEmitter component schema
- `NAV_AGENT_SCHEMA` — NavAgent component schema
- `CHAIN_BACKENDS` — Chain physics backends
- `ROPE_BACKENDS`
- `PHYSICS_CHAIN_SCHEMA` — PhysicsChain component schema (unified: particle chains + rigid chains) mode: "particle" = PBD/GPU/PhysX particle chain (formerly PhysicsRope) mode: "rigid"    = rigid linked chain (formerly PhysicsChain)
- `PHYSICS_ROPE_SCHEMA`
- `TWISTED_ROPE_SCHEMA`
- `WELD_TYPES` — Weld constraint types
- `WELD_CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA` — WeldConstraint component schema - Defines a physics weld between two entities Welds merge collision shapes from child into parent, creating compound bodies. When saved: stores entity IDs and offset When loaded: recreates weld during physics init
- `COLLISION_MODES` — Collision modes - determines how physics engine handles collisions Maps to PhysX PxPairFlags and shape flags
- `COLLISION_LAYERS` — Predefined collision layers (bitmask) Each entity belongs to one layer (collisionLayer) and can collide with multiple layers (collisionMask)
- `ENTITY_FLAGS_SCHEMA` — EntityFlags component schema - Unified flags for collision, visibility, and editor behavior This component centralizes all entity interaction flags: - Collision: layer/mask filtering, collision mode (solid/trigger/noPush/ghost) - Visibility: render visibility, layer masks, editor-only visibility - Editor: pickable, selectable, locked, hidden in hierarchy - Physics: weldable, pushable, sleepable PhysX Integration: - collisionLayer → PxFilterData.word0 - collisionMask → PxFilterData.word1 - collisionMode → PxPairFlags (eSOLVE_CONTACT, eDETECT_DISCRETE_CONTACT, etc.)
- `COMPONENT_SCHEMAS`
- `ENTITY_SCHEMA` — Complete entity schema (entity + components)
- `ENTITY_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA` — Entity state snapshot (for rewind)
- `WORLD_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA` — World snapshot schema
- `validatePhysicsRope`
- `createDefaultPhysicsRope`

## Notes & Examples

### ECS Architecture Pattern

The Entity Component System (ECS) separates data (Components) from behavior (Systems). Entities are lightweight IDs that group components. Systems query entities by component type and process them in bulk, enabling cache-friendly iteration and parallel execution.

**Example: Creating and querying entities**
```js
import { World } from 'engine/ecs/World.js';
import { Component } from 'engine/ecs/Component.js';
import { System } from 'engine/ecs/System.js';

// Define component types
class Position extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }
class Velocity extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }

// Create world and entities
const world = new World();
const player = world.createEntity();
player.add(new Position(0, 0, 0));
player.add(new Velocity(1, 0, 0));

// Movement system queries Position + Velocity
class MovementSystem extends System {
  query = [Position, Velocity];
  
  update(entities, dt) {
    for (const entity of entities) {
      const pos = entity.get(Position);
      const vel = entity.get(Velocity);
      pos.x += vel.x * dt;
      pos.y += vel.y * dt;
      pos.z += vel.z * dt;
    }
  }
}

world.addSystem(new MovementSystem());
world.update(0.016);  // Simulate 16ms frame
```

**See also:** [ECS v2](/engine/ecs.md) · [Engine Architecture](/engine/architecture.md)

### ECS Architecture Pattern

The Entity Component System (ECS) separates data (Components) from behavior (Systems). Entities are lightweight IDs that group components. Systems query entities by component type and process them in bulk, enabling cache-friendly iteration and parallel execution.

**Example: Creating and querying entities**
```js
import { World } from 'engine/ecs/World.js';
import { Component } from 'engine/ecs/Component.js';
import { System } from 'engine/ecs/System.js';

// Define component types
class Position extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }
class Velocity extends Component { x = 0; y = 0; z = 0; }
class Health extends Component { current = 100; max = 100; }

// Create world and entities
const world = new World();
const player = world.createEntity();
player.add(new Position(0, 0, 0));
player.add(new Velocity(1, 0, 0));
player.add(new Health(100, 100));
```

**Advanced: Complex queries**
```js
// Query entities with Position AND Velocity but NOT Static
class MovementSystem extends System {
  query = [Position, Velocity];
  exclude = ['Static'];  // Skip immovable objects
  
  update(entities, dt) {
    for (const entity of entities) {
      const pos = entity.get(Position);
      const vel = entity.get(Velocity);
      pos.x += vel.x * dt;
      pos.y += vel.y * dt;
      pos.z += vel.z * dt;
    }
  }
}

// Query with OR conditions
const damaged = world.query([Health], {
  filter: (e) => e.get(Health).current < e.get(Health).max
});
```

**Advanced: System groups and ordering**
```js
// Systems run in group order, within group by priority
world.addSystem(new InputSystem(), { group: 'input', priority: 0 });
world.addSystem(new AISystem(), { group: 'ai', priority: 0 });
world.addSystem(new MovementSystem(), { group: 'physics', priority: 0 });
world.addSystem(new CollisionSystem(), { group: 'physics', priority: 1 });
world.addSystem(new RenderSystem(), { group: 'render', priority: 0 });

// Groups run: input → ai → physics → render
world.update(0.016);
```

**Advanced: Component events**
```js
// React to component add/remove
world.onComponentAdded(Health, (entity, health) => {
  console.log('Entity', entity.id, 'health set to', health.max);
});

world.onComponentRemoved(Health, (entity) => {
  console.log('Entity', entity.id, 'died (health removed)');
});
```

**Gotchas:**
- **Adding components during iteration**: Safe, but new entities won't appear until next frame.
- **Removing entities**: Mark for deletion, processed at end of frame to avoid iterator invalidation.
- **Singleton components**: Use `world.getResource(Singleton)` for global state like Time, Input.

**See also:** [ECS v2](/engine/ecs.md) · [Engine Architecture](/engine/architecture.md)
